title: Neon Turtle in Plasma Orb
description: A glowing sea turtle swims inside a large transparent spherical plasma globe. Bright neon yellow, purple, and pink energy tendrils radiate from a central glowing red core, while various marine creatures including fish, jellyfish, and a crab float within the orb. A small human silhouette stands at the base of the central rod observing the scene. The orb rests on a black pedestal against a dark, lightning-filled background with coral silhouettes.
